finding: H1 is FALSIFIED, and decisively so — REVERSED. At the IIT 4.0 Φ-structure level, the relation-to-distinction ratio is HIGHER for LIFE-themed substrates (rd_ratio 1.63–1.96 at state 0101, all-16-state class mean 2.50) than for CONSCIOUSNESS-themed substrates (rd_ratio 0.5–1.0 at state 0101, class mean 0.875). The class separation is clean (consc_max=1.0 < life_min=1.64) and holds at every co-integrating state — life > consciousness in the relation/distinction race, never overlap. Reconciliation with H_281 (consciousness FLOOR at struct_ratio=1.0): the consciousness substrates pack the entire CES into the irreducible core (struct_ratio=total/big_phi=1.0), but within that core relations carry roughly equal or LESS Φ-mass than distinctions (rd_ratio ≤ 1.0). Life substrates spread Φ-mass into ~2× the distinction count (nd=10 vs 5) AND a quadratically larger relation pool (∝ nd²) — the relation pool dominates the ratio. The intuition that 'consciousness = binding = relation-rich' is FALSE on this IIT4 substrate panel at n=4.
verdict: 🔴 FALSIFIED — F320.1 SEPARATION FAIL · F320.2a ORDERING FAIL · F320.2b ROBUST FAIL (REVERSED) · F320.3 FAITHFULNESS 3/3 PASS · determinism PASS (4/7). The faithful IIT 4.0 Φ-structure relation/distinction ratio (sum_phi_r / sum_phi_d) does NOT separate consciousness-themed substrates above life-themed ones; it separates them BELOW. The hypothesized direction is REVERSED, decisively (life class mean 2.86× consciousness class mean across all 16 states). The faithfulness anchors PASS confirms the kernel is reading correct fields — the falsification is the measurement, not an instrument error. CLOSED-NEGATIVE: the 'consciousness = relation-rich Φ-structure' axis is ruled out for this n=4 ECA substrate panel (a_paper_negative_ok-eligible per project.tape).
honest_scope: n=4 ring · 5 substrates (3 life + 2 consciousness) + 2 anchors. Headline = single representative state 0101; F320.2 adds all-16-state robustness pass to rule out single-state artifact. The closed-negative direction (life > consciousness in rd_ratio) is structural for this substrate panel — life substrates carry nd=10 vs consciousness nd=5, the larger distinction pool unlocks a quadratically larger relation pool (∝ nd²), which dominates the per-distinction ratio. The closed-negative scope: 'rd_ratio does NOT separate IIT-canonical-XOR-integration above growth/replication ECA at n=4 small'. NOT a claim about phenomenal consciousness; NOT a claim that no Φ-structure feature separates the classes (H_281's struct_ratio = total / big_phi separates the OTHER way — the panel is informative under multiple Φ-structure projections, but rd_ratio is the wrong projection for the H1 direction).
reconcile_with_H_281: H_281 found CONSCIOUSNESS at the irreducibility floor (struct_ratio = total/big_phi = 1.0 exactly) and LIFE above (1.05–1.57). H_320 finds CONSCIOUSNESS at the relation/distinction floor (rd_ratio ≤ 1.0) and LIFE above (1.63–1.96). Both find life > consciousness in any structural-mass projection. The IIT4-canonical XOR substrates are MINIMAL-Φ-structure (fewer distinctions, fewer relations); life substrates are MAXIMAL-Φ-structure (more distinctions, more relations) — life > consciousness on multiple ortho projections. The relation/distinction ratio is therefore not a discriminator for the integrated-complex signature distinct from struct_ratio — both saturate life > consciousness on this panel.
verify_fence: The faithful big-Φ / sum_phi_d / sum_phi_r values are deterministic closed-form arithmetic (intrinsic-difference over purviews + 2nd-order overlap relations + structure-cut MIP, RFC-faithful IIT4 engine via stdlib/consciousness/iit4_bigphi).
